messages.content: Help me create a queue with a myWorkerFunction that processes tasks, setting the concurrency level to 5 and without specifying a payload size?

function.name: queue_1
function.description: This function creates a queue object with a specified worker function and concurrency level. It allows for tasks to be added to the queue and processed according to the concurrency level. Optional payload size can be specified to limit the number of tasks processed per worker call. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

worker.description: The worker function that processes each task. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

concurrency.description: The maximum number of tasks to be processed concurrently. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

payload.description: Optional. The number of tasks each worker function call should process at most. Default 0.0 This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.
